text: The register Mara opened in Lesson 10 was built for exactly this moment. Lessons 11 through 16 produced a finding precise enough to write down: a 14-versus-19 discrepancy, traced to 5 stale break-glass grants, now fixed and validated.

This becomes a new row, R-06, not an update to R-03. R-03 is about the break-glass procedure itself. R-06 is about the audit process's inability to detect direct assignment at all, going forward, on any segment.

R-06's compensating control has two parts: every Critical-tier audit must now be reconciled against the automation's direct-assignment report before closing, and future break-glass grants expire automatically through time-bound PIM and IAM session policies.
Status stays Mitigated, not Closed -- the same discipline as R-04. The register keeps tracking what's in place, so anyone checking later can confirm the control is still working.
